description: This PHP class 'ListViewDataEmailsSearchOnIMap' extends an abstract class and implements a 'search' method to fetch emails from an inbound email server, filter and process email data related to the SuiteCRM application. It manages pagination, ordering, and search parameters, integrating with email server checks and CRM data handling.

classes.name: ListViewDataEmailsSearchOnIMap
classes.description: A class for searching emails via IMAP with advanced filtering and pagination, tailored for SuiteCRM email list views.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs email search with server paging, filtering, sorting, and returns email data along with pagination info.

methods.name: retrieveEmailAssignedUser
methods.description: Retrieves assigned user info for an email record by its UID.
